fields.label: Malipopay Integration Enabled
fields.description: Master switch for the Malipopay channel. When off, no Malipopay API call is ever made and inbound webhooks are rejected.

fields.label: Outbound Mode
fields.description: Off: no collection is ever created at Malipopay. Log Only: creation is logged to Malipopay API Log but no HTTP call is made. Live: collections are created for Sales Orders on Land Acquisitions with 'Collect via Malipopay' ticked. Gates OUTBOUND creation only — inbound money on already-live collections is always accepted (a bill their side holds stays payable regardless of our switches).

fields.label: Inbound Mode
fields.description: Off / Log Only: webhook events and sweep results are persisted and logged but NO money is booked. Apply Payment: confirmed provider transactions are booked as Payment Entries through the shared payment core. Raw webhook events are persisted in EVERY mode — a real payment notification must never evaporate because a switch was off.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Malipopay API base. Same URL serves sandbox and live — the account stays in sandbox mode until Malipopay approves go-live.

fields.label: API Token (apiToken header)
fields.description: Secret key from the Malipopay dashboard (mp_sk_...). Sent as the apiToken header on every outbound call.

fields.label: Webhook Signing Secret
fields.description: The webhook's secret from the Malipopay dashboard (Settings → Webhooks). It signs every delivery (X-Malipopay-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). NOT the API token.

fields.label: Webhook Callback URL
fields.description: Copy this into the Malipopay dashboard (Settings → Developer Tools → Webhooks → Add Webhook; events Payment confirmed / failed / refunded). Populated from this site's public URL every time the form opens.

fields.options: Malipopay will POST JSON deliveries to the URL above, signed with the webhook's secret (paste that secret into Webhook Signing Secret). One webhook serves every Land Acquisition — deliveries carry the control number. Deliveries are attempted once (no retry): register only after this site has the receiver deployed. Every delivery is filed in Malipopay Webhook Event; money is never booked from a webhook amount (booking works from the itemised breakdown).

fields.label: Collection Amount Type
fields.description: FLEXIBLE accepts part-payments against the control number until the total is met — the installment model. Leave as FLEXIBLE unless Malipopay advises otherwise.

fields.label: Poll Auth Token
fields.description: Shared secret Malipopay must send when polling our reference_status endpoint (constant-time compared). Their poll is how TCB-collected money closes their bills and how dead numbers stop being payable — issue this token to Lockwood at Stage 1.

fields.label: Poll Allowed IPs
fields.description: Optional comma/newline-separated allowlist for reference_status callers (Lockwood supplies their egress addresses during UAT). Empty = no IP restriction (token still required).

fields.label: Daily Sweep Enabled
fields.description: The mandatory reconciliation sweep (Malipopay attempts webhook delivery only once — a missed one is otherwise lost). Runs off-peak from the persisted watermark below, never in the crowded midnight window.

fields.label: Sweep Watermark
fields.description: End time of the last SUCCESSFUL sweep. The next sweep resumes from here (minus overlap) instead of a fixed 48h window, so an outage longer than two days cannot open a blind spot. Machine-written; the sweep alerts when this grows older than 24h.

fields.label: External Entries Mode
fields.description: Reports money received outside Malipopay (TCB, manual receipts) as CREDIT/DEBIT so the Malipopay bill stops asking for it. Off: nothing runs. Log Only: works out what would be sent and writes it to Malipopay API Log, sends nothing. Live: sends. Separate from Outbound Mode on purpose, so turning this on cannot change how bills are created.
